svg.text: User query → multimodal executor → task completion
Side Panel — STT or text input
① Load settings · resolve provider mode · validate API keys
② Claim task tab · init Lane Supervisor · init Trace writer
③ resolvePerceptionRuntimeMode → initial mode decision (unified_vl | structured)
OrchestratorPlanner · Planner LLM (Kimi K2 P6 Turbo)
① buildTaskContract — field-value pairs · constraints · DOM signal context
② Decompose → TaskNode[] with dependencies · successCriteria · assumptions
③ inferToolProfile per node · set RuntimeLimits (difficulty: easy|medium|hard)
④ synthesizeBatchedExhaustivePlan for complex multi-step tasks
User approves / cancels / provides feedback (≥ 2 nodes)
Topology: serial | parallel · dependency resolution · budget guard (tokens / cost / time)
Tab coordination per node · retry policy · reroute depth cap (max 3)
Repeats until: done() · max_turns · stopped · awaiting_approval · awaiting_clarification · error
① waitForDomReady · ② Content-script bridge health check · ③ Stagnation fingerprint snapshot
④ Context compression (NONE→LIGHT→MEDIUM→HEAVY by token budget) · ⑤ Build LLM message history
Screenshot injected as image_url content block into executor turn
No separate perception VLM call — executor sees & reasons over raw pixels
Fireworks: kimi-k2p6-turbo · Moonshot: kimi-k2.6 · Groq: llama-4-scout
5-section prompt: LOCATION · CHANGES · BLOCKERS · VISUAL-ONLY · AFFORDANCES
Prior obs. window=5 · validatePerceptionTagIds() · lang/dir detection
LLM Completion · Executor Tier (Kimi K2 P6 Turbo — multimodal, VL-capable)
① prepareLlmTurnRequest — system persona + history + perception text or image_url block + plan step
② completeStream() streaming, max_tokens=4096, tool_choice:"auto" — raw think blocks kept in history
③ stripThinkTags() for logic/logs · cleanContent drives decisions · rawContent stored for reasoning continuity
④ Text-only → nudge (T2) → escalate (T3) · recoverToolCallsFromText() · 429 failover to fallback pool
HIGH/CRITICAL risk tools → approvalRequest pauses loop
User approve/deny → 120 s timeout · requireApprovals setting
Side panel overlay · resolveClarification() unblocks loop
Tool Execution (51 registered tools · DOM bridge via Content Script)
Stable hash element IDs · empty-page retry 300+500 ms · ToolResultCache idempotency guard · DOM-modifying refresh policy
Fingerprint: URL + element count + sorted sigs
escalate tool intercepted · summarizeTrajectory() distills history
Planner LLM (Kimi K2) takes over · ESCALATION_REFLECTION injected
De-escalates after plan issued · plannerTenure/plannerTurns tracked
Completion Kernel — done() intercept · multi-preflight gate
All preflights must pass — any failure → done() rejected, loop continues:
✓ all pass → CompletionEnvelope (contractKind · evidenceKeys · resultId · decisionReason) → LoopResult emitted
③ reroute → new TaskNode with repairObjective (max depth 3)
① Merge node TokenUsage + cost → SESSION_METRICS broadcast every 3 turns + on completion
② Build SubtaskSummary[] · reset tab group appearance · release tab
③ Save HTTP run trace · upsert DurableTaskRun · pruneOrchestratorCheckpoints

Agentic concepts: Task Decomp · Planner LLM · Multimodal Executor (VL) · Unified VL Perception · Structured Perception (fallback) · Tool Use · 2-Tier Escalation · Human-in-Loop · Context Compression · Evidence Accum. · 9-Preflight Completion · Stagnation Detection · Retry/Reroute · Parallelism · Token Tracking
